name: augenmass-workbench
description: A Claude Code skill for developers, auditors, privacy reviewers, and product teams in the EUDI Wallet ecosystem: ask in plain language to audit registrations for over-ask, explain privacy findings, decode and verify wallet artifacts, debug live wallet flows, and get concrete fixes. Backed by the bundled Rust CLI when platform-compatible, or by AUGENMASS_BIN on other platforms.
